about: Python number semantics for bf_core::py: seeded inputs and the value Python gave for each. A row is the inputs in the order of "inputs", then the output. Made by tools/studio_export/py_vectors.py.

numbers.f64: a Python float.hex() string: [-]0x1.<13 hex digits>p<signed decimal exponent>; zero is 0x0.0p+0 or -0x0.0p+0; a subnormal is 0x0.<13 hex digits>p-1022. Every float input is one of these, and so is every output of a case whose "output" is "f64" (compare bit for bit: the sign of zero is part of the answer)
numbers.int: a JSON integer, within 2**53. round(x) returns a Python int, so it has no minus zero: round(-0.3) is 0, where np.rint(-0.3) is -0.0. imod and ifloordiv take and give ints
